svg.title: LooNuH, loonuh.dev

div.p: i ship two kinds of things: web platforms (Go and Python backends, React and Next.js frontends, Postgres, self-hosted Docker) and firmware for real hardware, like ESP32, nRF52 and homemade radio protocols.
studying Electrical Engineering & IoT at UDG in Podgorica. most things get built with my buddy as MetaStack, a two-person team. open to junior roles and internships.
QR guest services for hotels and rentals. four services, one Postgres.
multilingual property management site for the Montenegrin market.
native music player for macOS & iOS that syncs between devices over Bonjour.
macOS port of danser-go, universal build for Apple Silicon & Intel.

footer.span: thanks for stopping by! here, have a baguette 🥖
the full thing lives at loonuh.dev
